name: Search Contacts
description: Search for contacts by name from your saved contacts list and retrieve their email addresses. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/user-list-contacts)

configurable_props.name: search
configurable_props.label: Search Query
configurable_props.description: Search for contacts by name (e.g., 'John Doe'). Searches display name, given name, and surname.

configurable_props.name: filter
configurable_props.label: Filter
configurable_props.description: Filter contacts by email address using [OData syntax](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/search-query-odata-syntax-reference). For example, `emailAddresses/any(a:a/address eq 'john@example.com')`. Note: $filter only works with the `address` sub-property of `emailAddresses`. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/user-list-contacts)

configurable_props.name: expand
configurable_props.label: Expand
configurable_props.description: Comma-separated list of relationships to expand and include in the response. See the [relationships table of the contact](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/contact?view=graph-rest-1.0#relationships) object for supported names.

configurable_props.name: select
configurable_props.label: Select
configurable_props.description: Comma-separated list of [properties](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/contact?view=graph-rest-1.0#properties) to include in the response.

configurable_props.name: maxResults
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of contacts to return
